title: OIS Document Payload Schema
description: Standard schema for exchanging data and security permissions of enterprise files.

id.description: Unique identifier of the document in the target index.

action.description: Lifecycle operation to perform on the target document index (UPSERT for creation/updates or DELETE for tombstones).

type.description: Repository type (e.g. sharepoint, s3, database, filesystem, cmis, bpmn2).

instance.description: Base URI of the scanned repository instance.

connectorVersion.description: Version of the repository connector used.

mimeType.description: RFC 2046 media type of the document.

text.description: Extracted text content from the document (utf-8).

claimCheckUri.description: URI reference pointing to the raw binary file in shared storage.

sidecarUri.description: URI reference pointing to the persistent <key>.ois.json sidecar envelope stored alongside the raw binary in cloud/lakehouse object storage (e.g. Apache Ozone, AWS S3).

sha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 cryptographic checksum of the raw binary payload, used for cloud migration integrity verification and deduplication.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the raw binary payload in bytes.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata map extracted from the source file, including standard CMIS repository properties and BPMN 2.0 workflow engine execution states. A single-valued property is a scalar; a multi-valued property (for example a CMIS multi-valued property or a document with several authors) is an array of the same type.

cmis:objectId.description: The unique identifier of the object in the CMIS repository.

cmis:name.description: The name of the object in the CMIS repository.

cmis:objectTypeId.description: The type of the CMIS object (e.g. cmis:document, cmis:folder).

cmis:createdBy.description: The user who created the CMIS object.

cmis:creationDate.description: The timestamp when the CMIS object was created.

cmis:lastModifiedBy.description: The user who last modified the CMIS object.

cmis:changeToken.description: The change token of the CMIS object.

cmis:versionLabel.description: The version label of the CMIS document.

cmis:isLatestVersion.description: Indicates whether this is the latest version of the CMIS document.

bpmn:processInstanceId.description: The unique identifier of the workflow process instance.

bpmn:processDefinitionId.description: The unique identifier of the BPMN 2.0 process definition.

bpmn:processDefinitionKey.description: The business key/identifier of the BPMN 2.0 process definition.

bpmn:processDefinitionName.description: The human-readable name of the BPMN 2.0 process definition.

bpmn:businessKey.description: The business key associated with the process instance.

bpmn:status.description: The execution status of the workflow instance.

bpmn:startDate.description: The timestamp when the process instance was started.

bpmn:endDate.description: The timestamp when the process instance completed or terminated.

bpmn:startUserId.description: The identifier of the user who initiated the process instance.

bpmn:activeTasks.description: List of active user tasks or activities in the process instance.

taskId.description: The unique identifier of the active task instance.

taskName.description: The human-readable name of the active task.

taskDefinitionKey.description: The activity ID/key of the task in the BPMN XML.

assignee.description: The user currently assigned to the task.

candidateUsers.description: Users who are candidates to claim/perform the task.

candidateGroups.description: User groups who are candidates to claim/perform the task.

createTime.description: The timestamp when the task was created.

bpmn:transitionEvent.description: Real-time event-driven BPMN 2.0 lifecycle transition notification triggering immediate ACL mutation or tombstone revocation.

eventType.description: The workflow lifecycle event that triggered the document or ACL state transition.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the workflow transition occurred.

previousStatus.description: Previous workflow or document lifecycle status prior to the transition.

newStatus.description: New workflow or document lifecycle status following the transition.

ois:provenance.description: Provenance and delegated multi-agent identity metadata (OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange RFC 8693) tracking who triggered the ingestion or migration operation.

jobId.description: Identifier of the OIS job execution that produced this payload.

triggeredBy.description: Trigger mechanism (e.g. scheduler, webhook, mcp-agent, manual).

onBehalfOf.description: Subject identifier (RFC 8693 'sub' / 'on_behalf_of') of the human user whose source permissions bounded the operation.

actorAgent.description: Actor identifier (RFC 8693 'act.sub') of the autonomous AI agent or service orchestrating the job on behalf of the human user.

ingestedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the document envelope was generated.

ois:governance.description: In-flight pre-embedding governance and PII redaction audit record.

decision.description: Policy decision applied prior to chunking, embedding, or target storage.

redacted.description: Indicates whether sensitive entities (e.g. PII) were redacted from the extracted text before downstream routing.

redactionCategories.description: Categories of sensitive data redacted (e.g. EMAIL, SSN, CREDIT_CARD, PHONE, IBAN).

policyId.description: Identifier of the governance policy or webhook rule evaluated.

evaluatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when governance evaluation completed.

evaluationPolicy.description: Normative security evaluation policy. Compliant consumers MUST enforce FAIL_CLOSED semantics: an absent or empty permissions array defaults to deny-all (never public), explicit 'deny' entries override 'read'/'write', and effective access is the intersection of repository, folder, and document ACLs.

inheritanceEnabled.description: Indicates whether the document inherits ACL settings from its folder structure.

identity.description: Unique identifier of the user or group (e.g. Active Directory SID or email).

identityType.description: Authentication namespace/type of the identity (e.g. windows-sid, oauth-group, user-principal-name, local-role, public, cmis-user, cmis-group, bpmn-assignee, bpmn-candidate-user, bpmn-candidate-group, or custom provider namespaces).

displayName.description: Human-readable label for debugging audit logs.

access.description: Permission rule matching the security constraint.

relationships.description: Optional Relationship-Based Access Control (ReBAC / Zanzibar / OpenFGA) relationship tuples preserved alongside static ACLs.

user.description: Subject or user-set in ReBAC notation (e.g. user:alice@company.com, group:finance#member).

relation.description: Relationship name (e.g. viewer, editor, owner, parent_folder).

object.description: Target object identifier in ReBAC notation (e.g. document:doc-554032-sp, folder:q3-ma).
